svg.desc: Four memory strategies as rows. Keep everything (ConversationBuffer) loses nothing until it overflows. Keep the newest (WindowedMemory) loses the beginning, where the task was stated. Compress the old (SummarisingMemory) loses detail chosen by the summariser. Write it down (FactStore) loses everything you did not choose, and is the only one that survives a restart.
